issues.on_page: Operating Expenses 166,111.92 (p1); p3 property tax request by fund includes Library & Cemetery Fund 37,925.47 of 357,424.80
issues.issue: The township also levies for a Library & Cemetery Fund, so part of the combined Operating Expenses is probably culture/recreation or health/welfare rather than streets/highways. The form gives no breakdown, so the township default (with review) is defensible.
